best_match.fbbt_definition: Transcriptional clusters corresponding to this cell type were identified in single-cell RNA-seq data from pupal stages (Xie et al., 2021). At 24h APF, the corresponding transcriptional cluster was identified using intersections between projection neuron drivers and GAL4 lines for differentially expressed genes, and clusters at other stages were matched to it based on shared differentially expressed genes and marker expression (Xie et al., 2021). Pupal form of the embryonically born uniglomerular antennal lobe projection neuron that will innervate antennal lobe glomerulus VA2 in the adult (Yu et al., 2010; Xie et al., 2021). It is a primary neuron that functions in the larval olfactory system and, during early metamorphosis, prunes the terminal branches of its dendrites and axon and then re-extends its dendrites into the developing adult antennal lobe and its axon into the mushroom body and lateral horn (Xie et al., 2021).

justification: VA2 adPNs (embryonic-born, remodelling). Up to the pupal stage the immature or pupal term is used (curator); FBbt #2220, release 2026-11-02. Lineage: the authors' per-cell `lineage` for this type in the main analysis: adPN 9, APL 1.
